title: Group consecutive Unicode characters
description: Implement a Python JSON program. Input is an object with a text string. Return an object with a runs array. Each run has char equal to one Unicode code point and count equal to the number of consecutive occurrences. Preserve order. Non-adjacent occurrences must be separate runs. An empty string produces an empty runs array. Do not normalize Unicode. Read exactly one JSON input from stdin and print exactly one JSON output. Use the Python standard library only.
